blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — Four people were killed in two separate vehicular accidents involving pineapple-hauling trucks in Manolo Fortich and Kadingilan, Bukidnon, on Wednesday and Thursday (Nov. 18 and 19). At around 4:30 a.m. on Thursday, two unidentified women died after the Suzuki motorcycle they were riding crashed into a parked Isuzu cargo dropside truck along the provincial road in Zone 1, Barangay Sankanan, Manolo Fortich.
